notes.title: Patch - Fix for settings causing game not to open
notes.notes: For some reason it was possible to get the game to try and set a resolution of 0x0 when changing the game settings. Sanity checks were added to try and prevent this. Hopefully it works!

notes.title: Achievement bug fixes...
notes.notes:
- Fixed the 99 year game achievement. Bad if/else statement...
- Removed the "Cheater" achievement

notes.title: Yeehaw Achievements and softened yearly changes for longer games
notes.notes: Yeehaw Achievements and softened yearly changes for longer games. Hopefully that means fewer stalks will go bankrupt before the game ends.
